title: Report the command-target mismatch instead of an unknown cwd at provider start
outcome: A provider start with a known validated cwd but a mismatched validated command reports the actual deciding failure and a useful bounded remedy while retaining the existing refusal and credit guards.
acceptance: A real provider-start regression with a known validated cwd and a mismatched command exposes an accurate bounded command-target refusal, preserves original custody, and produces no fabricated artifact association or credit.
